_comment: Claude Code settings template. Copy to ~/.claude/settings.json and customize.

hooks._comment: Kit hook-wiring liveness beacon (cc-workflow#1086). Its OWN group, like the context-freshness pair, so merge_settings' group-signature union cannot append-and-duplicate a neighbouring hook. Writes ~/.claude/.kit-hooks-alive by EXECUTING — the one assertion that a settings file cannot fake. Silent (no additionalContext), always exits 0.
FlightDeck session-open emit (cc-workflow#857 / S1.7). Fire-and-forget: emits a session activity_start event to the durable buffer + ingest, never blocks, always exits 0.

Context-freshness warn (cc-workflow#908) — its OWN startup group, not merged into FlightDeck's, so merge_settings' group-signature union can't append-and-duplicate the FlightDeck hook on already-provisioned hosts. Self-filters fresh startups via the first-event timestamp. Fire-and-forget, exit 0.
Context-freshness warn (cc-workflow#908) — see the startup matcher.

Default to Action (cc-workflow#732): block a turn that ends by asking permission to do something the agent already knows how to do. General sibling of precheck-asking-detector. Kill-switch: STOP_ACTION_BIAS_HOOK_DISABLED=1.

Inter-wave stall-guard for active /wavemachine campaigns (cc-workflow#736 async-aware, #1109 staleness): scripts/hooks/workflow/wavemachine-stall-guard.sh. In the dynamic-workflows model (migration §5) the per-wave Workflow runs ASYNC: the driver launches it, ends its turn, and is re-invoked on the completion verdict. So this guard reads current_action.action and NO-OPs on a legitimate async await (awaiting-verdict), a human pause (hold), or an in-progress promotion (promoting) — it blocks ONLY a genuinely-synchronous gap (wavemachine_active=true with the driver in a launch/idle-shaped action but the turn ending without the next launch). STALE state never blocks (#1109): a flag whose last_updated is older than 24 h (= WAVEMACHINE_STALE_SECONDS in state.py) or unreadable gets a systemMessage telling the human to verify, not advance. Full retire of the wavemachine_active plumbing is deferred to #751. See lesson_stop_hook_with_block.md and skills/wavemachine/SKILL.md (stall-guard contract).
FlightDeck session-idle emit (cc-workflow#857 / S1.7). Fire-and-forget heartbeat: emits a session 'idle' step when a turn ends. Never blocks, always exits 0, never emits a block decision.

Context-threshold reseed gate (cc-workflow#1225). Blocks a turn's end when the session's remaining context (persisted per session by statusline-command.sh) is at or below RESEED_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD_PCT (default 15), telling the agent to /reseed. Loop guards: stop_hook_active, and an armed reseed in flight. A missing or malformed reading never blocks; it is reported once per session after three consecutive misses (no age cutoff: an idle session's reading is still exact). Kill-switch: RESEED_CONTEXT_GATE_DISABLED=1.

Reseed revive acknowledgement (cc-workflow#1225). Removes <cwd>/.claude/reseed-ack when the submitted prompt is exactly /reseed revive, which is how reseed-kick.sh knows its keystrokes landed. Prints nothing, never blocks.

sqtk drain (cc-workflow#1236). When one of this repo's squawks (.claude/sqtk-mine.json, written by sqtk add) is answered, confirmed, rejected, retired or recorded, injects the change into the agent's context once, at the start of its next turn. No mine file or no SQUAWK_URL: exits before any network call. Fails open, never blocks.
FlightDeck session-close emit (cc-workflow#857 / S1.7). Fire-and-forget: emits a session activity_end event when the session ends. Never blocks, always exits 0.
